artboards.title: The audit — the same job, drawn too many ways

annotations.text: Round 1, 2026-09-08. Read Main first (the diagnosis and the four directions), then the Audit (the evidence, drawn), then the four directions below. The owner's read on 09-09: A is the base; B, C and D are out. The new ideas are on the Round 2 page.
The pick is the owner's (H-71). Nothing here is normative until the ADR moves to Accepted. Direction A is the floor every other direction also has to clear.

Round 2, 2026-09-09. Five levers, each one thing on top of A that no earlier canvas drew: a place (E), an instrument that travels (F), the shop's own sea (H), a single page (I), other people (K). Each board redraws the same home for the same morning. Round2 has the scoring, the combinations and the recommendation.
Letters continue from round 1 (A–D) and skip G and J, which were considered and dropped before drawing: G was Deck's figure-first ramp again, J was gestures the dock test already limits.
